# vaultwarden_organization_collection_group (Resource)

This resource gives a group access to a collection.

Access of other users and groups to the collection is left unchanged. Groups require the `ORG_GROUPS_ENABLED=true` setting on the Vaultwarden server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vaultwarden_organization" "example" {
  name = "Example"
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_collection" "example" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  name            = "Example Collection"
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_group" "example" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  name            = "Engineering"
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_collection_group" "example" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  collection_id   = vaultwarden_organization_collection.example.id
  group_id        = vaultwarden_organization_group.example.id
  read_only       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection_id` (String) ID of the collection
- `group_id` (String) ID of the group, for example `vaultwarden_organization_group.example.id`
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization

### Optional

- `hide_passwords` (Boolean) Whether passwords are hidden from the members of the group. Defaults to `false`
- `manage` (Boolean) Whether the members of the group can manage the collection, including its access. Vaultwarden reports a group that can edit the items and see their passwords as able to manage the collection, so `manage = false` is not reported as drift in that case. Defaults to `false`
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the members of the group can only view the items in the collection. Defaults to `false`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the collection access, in the format `<organization_id>/<collection_id>/<group_id>`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vaultwarden_organization_collection_group.example <org_id>/<collection_id>/<group_id>
```
